briefdescription.para: Create an instance of ScheduleDAGInstrs to be run within the standard MachineScheduler pass for this function and target at the current optimization level.

detaileddescription.para: This can also be used to plug a new MachineSchedStrategy into an instance of the standard ScheduleDAGMI: return new ScheduleDAGMI(C, std::make_unique<MyStrategy>(C), /*RemoveKillFlags=*/false)
Return NULL to select the default (generic) machine scheduler.

briefdescription.para: Methods with trivial inline returns are convenient points in the common codegen pass pipeline where targets may insert passes.

detaileddescription.para: Methods with out-of-line standard implementations are major CodeGen stages called by addMachinePasses. Some targets may override major stages when inserting passes is insufficient, but maintaining overriden stages is more work. addPreISelPasses - This method should add any "last minute" LLVM->LLVM passes (which are run just before instruction selector).

briefdescription.para: addInstSelector - This method should install an instruction selector pass, which converts from LLVM code to machine instructions.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before register allocation.
This method may be implemented by targets that want to run passes after prolog-epilog insertion and before the second instruction scheduling pass.
This pass may be implemented by targets that want to run passes immediately before machine code is emitted.
